product: Organic manure / cow dung / animal & vegetable fertilizers
source_name: World Bank WITS (World Integrated Trade Solution), mirroring UN Comtrade — India exports of HS 310100 by partner country, calendar year 2023
notes: Replaces an earlier lower-confidence 3-row dataset sourced from private trade-data aggregators (SeAir/ExportImportData.in), which did not independently verify against a primary database. WITS/UN Comtrade is the same primary-tier source already used for the site's other 20+ trade-data files (see research/unverified.md, Phase 2b methodology note). HS 310100 covers 'animal or vegetable fertilizers' broadly, not cow-manure specifically — India exported to 99 countries/regions in 2023 totaling USD 16,587,350 and 22,892,600 kg; the 10 rows above are the top destinations by value. Earlier secondary-source figures for Italy/France/USA (from the previous dataset) are not corroborated in this WITS pull and have been dropped rather than merged, to avoid mixing sourcing tiers in one table. The United States appears in both datasets (this one: USD 2.60M, 2023) though the exact figures differ, consistent with different data years/methodologies rather than a contradiction.
